title: Tirumala electric bus drivers stage protest demanding wage hike

ai.summary: Electric bus drivers in Tirupati staged a protest demanding higher wages and an end to alleged management harassment, with over 100 drivers causing 80 buses to stop operations.

facts.claim: Electric bus drivers in Tirupati staged a protest demanding higher wages and an end to alleged management harassment
facts.quote: The APSRTC Electric Hired Bus Drivers and Workers’ Union, affiliated with the CITU, staged a dharna in front of the Alipiri depot in Tirupati on Saturday, demanding an immediate wage hike and an end to alleged harassment by the management.

facts.claim: over 100 drivers caused 80 buses to stop operations
facts.quote: More than 100 drivers took part in the protest, resulting in around 80 electric buses scheduled to operate between Tirupati and Tirumala remaining off the road.
